== Pictures and Redirects ==

Hello. The picture of Berelain with the white background is from {{bwb}}. As that is a [[Wotwiki:Canon|canon]] source, we use that one in the template. As for redirects, here's how you do that. Go tot he page you want to redirect and edit it to add <nowiki>#REDIRECT [[target page]]</nowiki> and then add the appropriate [[:Category:Redirects|redirect category]]. Let me know if you have any other questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 01:21, January 25, 2012 (UTC)

== References ==

I took care of the references on [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] and [[Myriam Copan]]. For regular references from the books, the {{tl|Ref/book}} template takes care of all of the background coding and works just great. I'm not sure we can adapt that template for use on URL references. So, we go old school. Here's how we do that. When you know you're going to have the same reference multiple times in an article, you have to add a name to the reference. Like this: <nowiki><ref name="Example">www.exampleurl.com</ref></nowiki>. Then, when you want to use it again, simply type in <nowiki><ref name="Example" /></nowiki> and you're done. No need to type out or copy the URL again. Let me know if you need any more help. Also, I responded on my talk page about the BWB references. Lastly, thanks very much for adding those reference links! Great job! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 15:34, January 29, 2012 (UTC)

Really great job on the chapter summary you did. Very nice. I wanted to explain the few minor changes I made to it. 

If a section, like the Events heading you had, doesn't have anything to go into it, it doesn't need to be on the summary. Also, I saw the URL links you made to the category pages. Here's how to link those. It is the same code you would use to add an article to a category with one addition, a colon. <nowiki>[[:Category:Merchants]] and [[:Category:Merchants|this one]]</nowiki> will give you [[:Category:Merchants]] and [[:Category:Merchants|a link that looks different]] that goes to the same place. 

Again, really great job. Thanks for doing that! Let me know if you have any questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 11:47, January 30, 2012 (UTC)
